name: Case law: Germany, Bundesarbeitsgericht
label: Germany case law (Bundesarbeitsgericht)
coverage: 5624 published decisions of the Bundesarbeitsgericht, one file and one commit each, dated the day decided; 52302 citations of federal law linked to germany-law (6940 of them pinned to the article's version in force that day; the others are older than germany-law's record).
record_note: Court decisions, not laws: every commit is Kind: court. In-force is the day decided. The record ends at the corpus snapshot named in REPRODUCE.md.
